test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The mean score of class A of 40 students in the mathematics test of 30 marks is 23. The mean score of class B of 45 students in the same test is 22. What is the ratio of the mean score of both the classes to that of class A?
solution:
**Given:**

Mean of class A = 23

Mean of class B = 22

**Concept used:**

Mean = Sum of the terms/No. of terms

**Calculation:**

Total score of class A = 40 × 23

⇒ 920

Total score of class B = 45 × 22

⇒ 990

Total score both the classes = 1910

Mean score of two classes together = 1910/85

Ratio = 1910/85 : 23

⇒ 382/17 : 23

⇒ 382 : 391

**∴ The ratio of the mean score of both the classes to that of class A is 382 : 391**
